## Review checklist

- [ ] No secret, credential, private payload, or generated local evidence is committed.
- [ ] UI changes include responsive, keyboard, accessibility and visual evidence where applicable.
- [ ] API changes regenerate/pin the client and preserve cross-repository compatibility.
- [ ] Documentation and API paths have CODEOWNERS review when branch protection is active.
- [ ] Project status is updated only after commit, test, and review evidence exists.
